description: The Altarus offering provides a premier platform and rapid development tools for creating, extending, and deploying secure enterprise applications to the desktop, mobile devices, or handheld devices. Our product facilitates efficient data transfer while allowing for unprecedented real-time performance, mission critical reliability and security. Our product also enables companies to leverage existing IT resources - I.e., LAN or WAN, satellite, wired, or dial-up connection - while extending new information access methods.
